Primary.$description: Use to emphasise primary content in relation to other elements nearby.

Secondary.$description: Use for most body text, and in supportive elements that give context to content that's close to it.

Tertiary.$description: Use in form inputs for placeholders, and for the label that says a field is ‘Optional’. Avoid using elsewhere.

Guide.$description: Use for links and for external link icons that appear in line with link text.

Negative.$description: Use for links and for external link icons that appear in line with link text.
